what_i_did: Copied models/horse-shelter (build.py, make_views.py, hero_check.py, run.sh) and reshaped it: same 4.6 x 5.5 m plan, origin, -Y front gable with the stable door, same five construction states and STATE groups, same part names and material names (Glass_Dark is the only new material, for the new windows).

views/hero.png is the only scoring target: the harness mask of mj hero.png, cut at the ground line (drops the dirt patch) and with the right corner stones filled from a traced polygon (the mask notched them). All three sheet views are dropped: view_front and view_back are the same gables but drawn with walls ~2.3x as tall as wide and eave tips at half height (hero: about a third), and view_side is a 3/4 view, not orthographic. The back gable's look (no door, plain planks, curved braces) still came from the sheet.
hero_check.py scores from the MJ hero's direction (front gable on the right, -X long side on the left); recalibrated for this hero on a yaw 26-48 x elevation 0-18 grid to 36 deg yaw, 2 deg up.

Plates at 2.45 m, a bell-flared roof whose pitch eases from 57 deg at the ridge to 25 deg at the eave edge (deck underside ~5.1 m at the ridge), 0.75 m flared eaves, 0.4 m gable overhang, a ridge that sags 0.1 m mid-length, a 0.4 x 0.3 m ridge beam that kicks 0.6 m up at the front and is yawed 2 deg, walls that splay out to 1.1x toward the ground, and a 0.1 m lean toward +X at the top.

Fat 0.34 m chamfered posts, 0.28 m plates and ties, curved knee braces, stepped eave corbels, bell-curved principal and common rafters, chunky chamfered footing stones with big corner blocks, round boulders and a flagstone threshold, big 0.56 m shake courses, an oversized 1.8 x 3.05 m arched stable door with fat lintel, lower leaf with Z brace and strap hinges, upper leaf swung 55 deg out on its hinge, a dark recess behind, a gable window with a cross, arched windows on both long sides, and a toy hay rack (timber shelf, iron bars, heaped hay) left of the door.

Triangles: planned 212, foundation 944, frame 2,616, roof 5,712, complete 8,320 (budget 9k). 14 meshes, one flat material each. Bounds 6.55 x 7.17 m (normal 6.43 x 6.88), so the width:depth ratio (0.91 vs 0.93) is close to the normal model's for the game's rescale.
good: Hero silhouette IoU 0.831 from the hero's direction; the bell roof, kicked ridge beam, flared eaves, splayed walls and big arched door all read at small size.
Construction stages read as a sequence and keep the charming shapes: stakes with drooping string lines, chunky footing, curved toy frame, bell roof on the open frame, finished stable.
Drop-in: same states, part names and material names as the normal model, nearly the same footprint ratio.
off: Timber stays named Timber_Brown (so the game's role and naming match the normal model) but is coloured the hero's salmon pink; Stone_Teal is the hero's grey-green.
The hero's upper door leaf shows almost face-on and arched; mine is a three-board leaf opened 55 deg with a flat-stepped top.
The hero walls bulge softly; mine splay linearly-ish toward the footing (a vertex deform), not a rounded bulge, to stay inside the triangle budget.
The hero has a deeper visible eave on its long side at nearly level height; my far eave reads a little higher because of the harness lens perspective.
Sheet views were not scored (all three dropped, see Views), so there is no sheet IoU.
The hero camera was calibrated on this model (grid search), so the hero number is a guide.

rounds.change: First charming build: bell roof 63->26 deg, plates 2.45, 0.85 m eaves, bulge 0.055, lean 0.1, sag 0.16, kick 0.55; hero camera 26 deg yaw / 5 up.
Lower roof (56->27 deg, deck lift 0.30), plates 2.6, 0.9 m eaves; hero camera recalibrated on a grid to 36 deg yaw / 2 up (0.769 at the old camera).
Taller walls (2.9) and a 52 deg top pitch, door and windows raised to match.
Plates 2.7, 56 deg top, eaves cut to 0.62 m, bulge 0.08, kick 0.7.
Low walls (2.45) under wide flared eaves (0.95 m, 54->25 deg), door/windows/rack lowered.
Steeper top (57 deg), eaves 0.75 m, bulge 0.10, sag 0.10: aspect matches the hero (h/w 0.838 vs 0.836).
Tried shorter overhangs (0.55 eave, 0.32 gable): worse, reverted.
Upper door leaf opened 55 deg instead of 78 so its face shows, lighter pink planks against salmon timbers, darker stones; final 768 px / 48 samples render.

moving_parts: None (the game poses buildings itself); construction stages are exported as variants/planned, foundation, frame, roof, complete.
creative_additions: Drooping string lines and chamfered stakes in the planned stage, round boulders and a flagstone threshold at the footing, stepped eave corbels, arched windows on both long sides, and a slight crook (2 deg yaw) in the kicked ridge beam.
